title: Persona v0.1 (KB-USR-G01 six elements + G03 thresholds)
description: A behavioural persona. Clustering is by goal x behaviour x constraint, never by demographics: background is carried for colour only and is excluded from the differentiation check. All six G01 elements are required; a persona missing any of them, or remaining low-confidence without explicitly scoped E3+ calibration, gets eligible_for_scoring=false and its simulated evidence cannot support a score.

label.description: One line: identity + the key behavioural trait (KB-USR-G01).

archetype.description: KB-USR-G02 requires the set to cover high_need, skeptic and edge_case at minimum.

background.description: Context only. Explicitly NOT a clustering basis and NOT part of the differentiation check.

goal_statement.description: Job statement: when [situation], I want to [job], so I can [outcome].

workaround_cost.description: >=4 forces switching_forces.push >= 4 (KB-USR-F02) and marks a strong pain (F04).

priority_score.description: frequency x severity x workaround_cost, computed by program.

barriers.description: Why this persona might not adopt: learning cost, price, trust, incumbent, permissions.

behavior_keys.description: The only fields read by the differentiation check. NEW-DECISION-U01: two personas sharing >=4 of these five keys are judged homogeneous.

value_threshold.description: KB-USR-G03. What must be true for this persona to consider the product worth it.

rejection_threshold.description: KB-USR-G03. The point at which this persona walks away.

rejection_reasons.description: KB-USR-P01 item 2: at least one CONCRETE reason to refuse. Vague filler such as 'might not be interested' fails review; name the price, the data question, the permission, the learning cost.

confidence.description: low when goal / pains / alternative are all assumptions; such a persona cannot solely support a score (KB-USR-F01).

eligible_for_scoring.description: Program-set. false when any G01 element is missing or confidence is low.

calibrated_by_real_evidence.description: E3+ evidence ids that calibrated this persona. Empty array means pure simulation (E2 ceiling).

carried_from_previous.description: True when the persona_id is inherited from previous_validation_results.personas_digest (spec R-07).
